name: Off-Highway Vehicle
description: Any motorized vehicle built for cross-country travel on natural terrain, motorcycles, related two-wheelers and minibikes among them; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria is one.

restrictions.rule: Built for cross-country travel on land, snow, ice, marsh or other natural terrain; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 117(a)

restrictions.rule: Must be registered and insured, except when ridden on the rider's own land or on land whose owner consents
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 119

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting a motorcycle helmet standard, except on an Indian reserve, a Metis settlement, or land where registration isn't required, and except a Sikh rider who wears a turban
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 128.1; Off-highway Vehicle Regulation, Alta. Reg. 319/2002, s. 9.1

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on any part of a highway, except to cross it directly or where a ministerial order or permit or a municipal bylaw allows it; never on a boulevard or a divided highway's median
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 120; Off-highway Vehicle Regulation, Alta. Reg. 319/2002, s. 3

restrictions.rule: Riders under 14 may not ride on a highway, and ride on public property only supervised by someone 18 or older on the passenger seat or close by
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Regulation, Alta. Reg. 319/2002, s. 2

restrictions.rule: Applicants under 18 need a parent's or guardian's consent to register one
restrictions.citation: Off-highway Vehicle Regulation, Alta. Reg. 319/2002, s. 14

restrictions.rule: Ridden on a highway where allowed, it's subject to the rest of the Traffic Safety Act as a vehicle
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 118(1)
